idea-plugin.name: Panda Vivid Black & Modern Dark Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Panda Vivid Black — Panda Syntax token semantics on a pure-black Vivid Black UI.

Fuses the Panda Syntax palette (pink keywords, teal strings, blue functions, italic teal types) with a deep-black Vivid Black shell. Tuned for Operator Mono.

Also includes Panda Modern Dark and Panda Modern Cyan. Available for VS Code.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.1
  • Panda Modern Cyan: Dart field / getter / setter declarations and references use purple (#B084FF); instance and static method calls and tear-offs use blue (#79B8FF). Method declarations, top-level function calls and named-argument labels are unchanged
1.3.0
  • New theme: Panda Modern Cyan (+ Islands variant), based on Panda Modern Dark, with cyan types (#00C9B0) and blue properties / named arguments (#79B8FF)
1.2.1
  • Dart: named-argument labels (DART_PARAMETER_REFERENCE) cyan in Modern Dark; static getters like WidgetsBinding.instance (DART_STATIC_GETTER_REFERENCE) use the property colour
  • All Dart/Kotlin/Logcat keys verified against Android Studio 2026.2 jars; invented keys removed, real keys (method tear-offs, LOGCAT_V2_*, LOGCAT_FILTER_*) added
1.2.0
  • New theme: Panda Modern Dark (+ Islands variant), ported from the VS Code Panda Modern Dark
  • Android Studio tuning for Kotlin/Compose, Dart/Flutter, Android XML, Gradle, TOML, Logcat, diff & VCS
1.1.0
  • Android Studio tuning: explicit Kotlin (KOTLIN_*) and Dart/Flutter (DART_*) keys
  • Java, Android XML, Groovy/Gradle, JSON/YAML/TOML, console ANSI, Logcat, diff & VCS colors
1.0.3

1.0.1

  • Terminal (console) background now follows theme
  • Buttons: shadow off, primary button accent darkened
1.0.0
